text: 商务部外资司司长孟华婷在23日举行的国新办新闻发布会上回应中美双方成立贸易理事会、投资理事会进展的有关提问时说，目前，中美双方经贸团队正在就贸易理事会架构、职能、运行模式等具体安排保持密切沟通，并探讨推进各自300亿美元规模的对等降税框架安排。中方正在就相关降税安排建议广泛征求国内企业、商协会、地方政府、美资企业商协会等利益相关方意见，美方也在就贸易理事会及对等降税安排征求公众评论意见。双方将保持密切交流，尽快商定具体产品降税安排并推动实施，进一步拓展双边贸易。（新华社）
text_en: Meng Huating, Director of the Foreign Investment Administration Department of the Ministry of Commerce, responded at a press conference on the 23rd to questions about progress on the establishment of trade councils and investment councils between China and the US. He said that currently, economic and trade teams from both sides are maintaining close communication on specific arrangements such as the council's structure, functions, and operating model, and are exploring the advancement of a framework arrangement for reciprocal tariff reduction of around USD 30 billion each. China is widely soliciting opinions from domestic enterprises, trade associations, local governments, and US-invested business associations on the proposed tariff reduction arrangements, while the US is also seeking public comment on the trade council and reciprocal tariff reduction. Both sides will maintain close exchanges, finalize specific product tariff reduction arrangements as soon as possible, and promote implementation to further expand bilateral trade. (Xinhua News Agency)
